name: COMOWARE 1 inch Reduced-Shank Drill Bit- 1/2 inch Shank, HSS Silver and Deming, Black & Gold
description: High Quality Material - High Speed Steel M2 Black and Gold, resists corrosion, ensures outstanding durability, sharpness and capability, reduces the friction and runs cooler. Black and Gold Oxide Finish - Premium gold titanium and black nitride dual coating can apply lubricant better for smoother drilling and is more durable and corrosion resistant than the regular black surface. 135-degree & Split Point - Increases cutting speed with self-centering and prevents walking, clears chips and particles faster. The split point tip can increase the wear resistance. 135-degree penetrates hard material without a pilot hole and produces small chips to reduce clogging. Special Design - Unique tri-flat shank and 1/2" reduced shank can lock onto chuck to permit portable drilling. The special design can drill tough and high-tensile strength materials. General Purpose - It is ideal for drilling steel, copper, aluminum, brass, oak, maple, MDF, pine, PVC, polycarbonate, acrylic, ABS, nylon and composite materials. name: Buffalo Tools PS07535 115-Piece Titanium Drill Bit Set
description: Your DIY projects just got easier with the Pro Series 115-Piece Titanium Drill Bit Set. It includes 115 different sizes for drilling everything from wood and metal to plastic and more. With this titanium bit set, you can hang photos or drywall and install shelving for storage or new hardwood floors. They are constructed of titanium for long life and high usage so you will get years of projects completed. These general purpose drill bits can be used with a cordless drill for home improvement and general maintenance projects around the house and so much more. You will find no end to the uses for this titanium-coated set. They are packaged inside a plastic carry case to keep bits organized and easy to find. The set includes both SAE and metric sizes. There are 29 fractional sizes ranging from 0.0625" to 0.5" in 64th increments and 26 letter sizes from A to Z. It also includes 60 bits numbered as wire gauge sizes from 1 to 60.
